SELECT sps.employee_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id) AS session_count, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, sp.start_time, sp.end_time)) / 60, 0) AS duration, COALESCE(SUM(sp.view_count), 0) AS view_count, COALESCE(SUM(sp.sales_revenue), 0) AS sales_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(sp.refund), 0) AS refund, COALESCE(SUM(sp.net_sales), 0) AS net_sales, COALESCE(SUM(sp.investment), 0) AS investment FROM schedule_performance_staff sps INNER JOIN schedule_performance sp ON sps.schedule_performance_id = sp.id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(sp.start_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND sps.is_deleted = 0
AND sps.employee_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY sps.employee_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp.view_count), 0) AS view_count, COALESCE(SUM(sp.sales_revenue), 0) AS sales_revenue FROM schedule_performance sp INNER JOIN schedule_performance_staff sps ON sp.id = sps.schedule_performance_id AND sps.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sps.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND sp.live_room_id = #{liveRoomId}

SELECT sps.employee_id, COALESCE(SUM(sp.view_count), 0) AS view_count, COALESCE(SUM(sp.sales_revenue), 0) AS sales_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(sp.pay_combo_cnt), 0) AS pay_combo_cnt FROM schedule_performance sp INNER JOIN schedule_performance_staff sps ON sp.id = sps.schedule_performance_id AND sps.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sps.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT DATE(sp.start_time) AS stats_date, COALESCE(SUM(sp.view_count), 0) AS view_count, COALESCE(SUM(sp.sales_revenue), 0) AS sales_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(sp.refund), 0) AS refund, COALESCE(SUM(sp.net_sales), 0) AS net_sales, COALESCE(SUM(sp.investment), 0) AS investment FROM schedule_performance sp INNER JOIN schedule_performance_staff sps ON sp.id = sps.schedule_performance_id AND sps.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sps.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND sp.live_room_id = #{liveRoomId} AND DATE(sp.start_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(sp.start_time) ORDER BY stats_date
